# Bridge Studio — website (Render)

Static site, no build step. Each bridge is one self-contained page:

| URL | Bridge |
|---|---|
| `/` | landing page (all bridges) |
| `/saltina/` | Hängebrücke Saltina / Grindji, Brig-Glis |
| `/issyk-kul-2/` | Issyk-Kul Crossing II |
| `/issyk-kul/` | Issyk-Kul first study |
| `/varese/` | Varese · Campo dei Fiori |
| `/chur/` | Ruina Grünfels, Chur |

Pages are the **web edition**: licence check + obfuscation, DXF downloads (origin / geolocated) behind the
"DXF password" box. They are generated by the main `bridge-studio` repo (`core/build/build_all.py` → `website/`);
don't edit them here — rebuild there and copy `website/` over this folder.

## Deploy on Render
1. Push this folder to GitHub (its own repo, e.g. `bridgestudio-site`).
2. Render → **New + → Blueprint** → choose the repo → Apply. (`render.yaml` sets everything.)
   Alternative: **New + → Static Site**, Build Command `echo ok`, Publish Directory `.`.
3. Every push to `main` redeploys.

## Custom domain (e.g. bridgestudio.com)
1. Buy the domain.
2. Render → the site → **Settings → Custom Domains → Add** `bridgestudio.com` (Render adds `www.` too).
3. At the domain registrar's DNS:
   - `bridgestudio.com` → **ALIAS/ANAME** to `bridge-studio.onrender.com` (or **A** `216.24.57.1` if ALIAS isn't offered)
   - `www` → **CNAME** `bridge-studio.onrender.com`
   - delete any `AAAA` records for the domain
4. Click **Verify** in Render; the HTTPS certificate is issued automatically.
   (Use the exact `…onrender.com` name Render shows for your site.)
